mapper.select: SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_IMG, p.CONTEST_ID, c.TITLE AS CONTEST_TITLE, p.PET_NAME, p.PET_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.CONTENT, p.FILE_PATH, p.LIST_FILE_NAME, p.POPUP_FILE_NAME, p.MEDIA_TYPE, p.SCORE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.COMMENT_COUNT, p.SHARE_COUNT, p.CREATED_AT FROM POST p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID JOIN CONTEST c ON p.CONTEST_ID = c.CONTEST_ID WHERE p.CONTEST_ID = #{contestId} ORDER BY p.SCORE DESC, p.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT w.WINNER_ID, w.CONTEST_ID, c.TITLE AS CONTEST_TITLE, w.AWARD_TYPE, w.PRIZE_NAME, w.AWARDED_AT, p.POST_ID, p.PET_NAME, p.PET_TYPE, p.TITLE AS POST_TITLE, p.FILE_PATH, p.LIST_FILE_NAME, p.POPUP_FILE_NAME, p.SCORE, u.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_IMG FROM CONTEST_WINNER w JOIN CONTEST c ON w.CONTEST_ID = c.CONTEST_ID JOIN POST p ON w.POST_ID = p.POST_ID JOIN USERS u ON w.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE w.CONTEST_ID = #{contestId} ORDER BY CASE w.AWARD_TYPE WHEN 'SUPER_STAR' THEN 1 WHEN 'RISING_STAR' THEN 2 WHEN 'BRIGHT_STAR' THEN 3 WHEN 'ROOKIE_STAR' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET SCORE = SCORE + #{scoreDelta}, VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + #{viewDelta}, LIKE_COUNT = LIKE_COUNT + #{likeDelta}, COMMENT_COUNT = COMMENT_COUNT + #{commentDelta}, SHARE_COUNT = SHARE_COUNT + #{shareDelta} WHERE POST_ID = #{postId};
mapper.insert:
-- 1위 SUPER_STAR, 2위 RISING_STAR, 3위 BRIGHT_STAR INSERT INTO CONTEST_WINNER (CONTEST_ID, POST_ID, USER_ID, AWARD_TYPE, PRIZE_NAME) SELECT p.CONTEST_ID, p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, CASE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.SCORE DESC) WHEN 1 THEN 'SUPER_STAR' WHEN 2 THEN 'RISING_STAR' WHEN 3 THEN 'BRIGHT_STAR' END AS AWARD_TYPE, CASE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.SCORE DESC) WHEN 1 THEN 'Paw Star 골드 트로피 & 백화점 상품권 50만원' WHEN 2 THEN 'Paw Star 실버 트로피 & 반려동물 용품 30만원' WHEN 3 THEN 'Paw Star 브론즈 트로피 & 고급 사료 세트' END AS PRIZE_NAME FROM POST p WHERE p.CONTEST_ID = #{contestId} ORDER BY p.SCORE DESC LIMIT 3;
-- 순위(1,2,3위) 외 하트 순 1위 ROOKIE_STAR 선정 INSERT INTO CONTEST_WINNER (CONTEST_ID, POST_ID, USER_ID, AWARD_TYPE, PRIZE_NAME) SELECT p.CONTEST_ID, p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, 'ROOKIE_STAR' AS AWARD_TYPE, '루키 스타 특별상 & 루키 배지' AS PRIZE_NAME FROM POST p WHERE p.CONTEST_ID = #{contestId} AND p.POST_ID NOT IN ( SELECT POST_ID FROM CONTEST_WINNER WHERE CONTEST_ID = #{contestId} ) ORDER BY p.LIKE_COUNT DESC, p.SCORE DESC LIMIT 1;
